scope: All accessible PRs in tachyon-zcash/ragu; not cross-repository GitHub history.

method.review_events: GraphQL pullRequests(first:50), paginated; reviews(first:100) for every PR, with nested completeness assertions.
method.discussion_comments: REST repos/tachyon-zcash/ragu/issues/comments, per_page=100, all pages; filtered to collected PR numbers.
method.source_role: Reviewer-side feedback is primary. Own-PR responses, other participants, and review states provide context.
method.inference: Themes and comparative emphasis are qualitative inferences from authored feedback, not statistical estimates or personality claims.
limitations: Deleted or inaccessible comments and unsubmitted drafts are not recoverable.
The capture is a paginated retrieval, not an atomic GitHub snapshot.
The collection indexes review feedback; it does not re-audit all historical PR diffs.
Examples do not prove current findings or establish that all account-attributed comments were handwritten.
